title: Contract evaluation set v2
assertion: 63 documents to 60 codes and 80 pages: multi-row tables, contract-plus-exhibit pairs, scans with OCR errors or their own OCR layer, struck-through rates, each marked faithful or not; its hash covers the pages as read, and a changed set refuses comparison

outcome.contractSetV2: every true field quotes its page as a person sees it, and on an unfaithful case where the text as read differs the field as a faithful copier of that text would write it; the gate counts wrong-but-verified fields apart from rejected and missed ones, holds them to zero on faithful cases, and refuses comparison when the set changes
